basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biochemistry, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has one post of Senior Project Assistant (SPA) under an ICMR (New Delhi)-funded project, Project Code I-1673, with a project duration of 5 months. The post carries a consolidated salary of ₹22,793 per month. Indian citizens with a three-year Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Animal Sciences or Life Sciences, or a Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject, may send their CV and documents as a single PDF file to [email protected]. The last date is seven (7) days from the date of the advert

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: About 18 November 2026 (seven days from the date of the advertisement)
important_dates.interview_date: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail

age_limit.details: The age of the candidate as on the last date of submission of applications should not be less than 25 years or more than 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST candidates will be granted as per Government of India (GoI) rules. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: The application is made by email only. The notice gives these instructions:
Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), including personal details.
Add self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Combine the CV and all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the PDF file to [email protected].
Send it within seven (7) days from the date of the advertisement (11 November 2026), that is, by about 18 November 2026.
Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), including personal details
Self-attested copies of all mark sheets
Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates
Incomplete applications and applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The notice does not mention an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens only. Hands-on experience in handling Molecular Biology instruments. Working knowledge of computers. The age of the candidate as on the last date of submission of applications should not be less than 25 years or more than 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST candidates will be granted as per Government of India (GoI) rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Assistant (SPA)
content_sections.text: The application is made by email only. The notice gives these instructions: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), including personal details Self-attested copies of all mark sheets Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Caste certificate (if claimed) Experience certificates Details of publications Incomplete applications and applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The notice does not mention an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview by e-mail. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The decision of the competent authority regarding acceptance or rejection of applications, eligibility or suitability of candidates, and the mode and criteria of selection shall be final and binding on all applicants. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice; they will be sent to shortlisted candidates by e-mail.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) post of Senior Project Assistant (SPA) in the Department of Biochemistry, AIIMS New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date is seven (7) days from the date of the advertisement, 11 November 2026, which works out to about 18 November 2026; late and incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A three-year Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Animal Sciences or Life Sciences, or a Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject, with a handwritten addition of "+1 year experience" on the notice; hands-on experience with Molecular Biology instruments and working knowledge of computers are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age should not be less than 25 years or more than 35 years as on the last date of submission of applications, with age relaxation for SC/ST candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated salary of ₹22,793 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send your updated CV with personal details, self-attested copies of mark sheets, qualification certificates, caste certificate (if claimed), experience certificates and details of publications as a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview by e-mail and must bring all original documents for verification at the interview; no TA/DA will be paid.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the AIIMS Senior Project Assistant appointment?
faq.answer: The post is under an ICMR-funded project, Project Code I-1673, whose duration is 5 months.
